svg.text: Where this part sits, and why

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: This is the last map in the course, and it is the whole course. A coherent optical module is a stack of every part: the DSP theory

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: supplies the algorithms, the Ethernet part supplies the measurement discipline, and this part supplies the electrical interfaces

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: that connect them to the world.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Read it as a build order. Each layer assumes the ones below it, and a problem at any layer is diagnosed with the chapters at that

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: layer rather than by re-examining the layer above.
